name: Game Day
concept: A time-aware board that changes personality with the hockey calendar: home game day, away game day, day-after recap and off-day standings, chosen from the schedule clock (override with ?now=).
panels: Countdown / where to watch / final score / standings
Tale of the tape / three stars / leaders
Head to head and form / standings impact / streaks and milestones
Players to watch / next up / schedule
